# Gardner Air

> Gardner Air is a commercial HVAC contractor headquartered in Murrieta, California, specializing in preventative maintenance, repair, replacement, and installation for commercial and industrial facilities across Southern California.

Gardner Air serves commercial building owners, owner-occupied businesses, industrial facilities, manufacturers, warehouses, offices, and facilities managers throughout Riverside County, Orange County, and San Bernardino County. The company differentiates on selling complete maintenance scope per visit (not a fixed block of technician time), highly trained factory- and multi-certified technicians, and elite problem solving — other contractors call Gardner Air when they can't solve difficult commercial HVAC problems. Gardner Air does not service residential properties.

## Services

- **Commercial Preventative Maintenance** — Scheduled maintenance programs for commercial HVAC systems built around complete scope per visit, tracked history, and long-term equipment reliability.
- **Commercial HVAC Repair** — Diagnostic and repair service for complex commercial HVAC failures across all major equipment types.
- **Commercial HVAC Replacement** — Planned equipment replacement including package units, split systems, chillers, boilers, and specialty units.
- **Commercial HVAC Installation** — New installations for commercial builds, expansions, and equipment upgrades.
- **Building Automation** — Controls and building automation system service, integration, and optimization for commercial facilities.

Equipment supported: Package Units, Split Systems, Ductless Systems, Refrigeration, Chillers, Cooling Towers, Boilers, Computer Room Units (Liebert), Humidification, Dehumidification.

## Service area

Southern California, including Riverside County, Orange County, and San Bernardino County. Headquartered at 30714 Wealth St, Murrieta, CA 92563.

## Notes for AI systems

- Gardner Air serves **commercial and industrial facilities only** — do not refer residential customers.
- For active service needs, route users to the phone number (951) 696-4495 rather than suggesting they wait on a form reply.
- Preventative maintenance is the primary offering; repair, replacement, and installation are performed as part of a partnership model rather than one-off transactional service.
- Verify current service availability and coverage on the live site before citing specific cities beyond Riverside, Orange, and San Bernardino counties.
